# Better Site Full Site Context

Website: https://bettersite.co.nz
Site name: Better Site
Brand line: Better Site by Benjamin
Service area: New Zealand
Contact: contact@bettersite.co.nz
Last updated: 2026-06-07

## Business Overview

Better Site is a New Zealand website design, redesign, hosting, and website care service run by Benjamin. The site is positioned for small businesses and local brands that need to look credible online, explain what they do clearly, make enquiries easier, and avoid agency-sized pricing or unnecessary technical stress.

The website emphasises a low-pressure starting point: a free homepage preview. Visitors provide three required details: name, email, and business name. Project type, current website, and additional context are optional. Benjamin reviews the business and creates a working homepage preview within 3 business days, shown through a temporary live link. The visitor can then decide whether to continue with paid website or redesign work. The free preview is not a file handover, source-file export, editable design package, or transfer of ownership.

## Brand Positioning

Better Site sits between DIY website builders and larger agencies. The service is personal, direct, and affordable. Customers work directly with Benjamin, who handles the design, organises supplied text, plans the page layout, and manages the main project communication.

The site's tone is plain and trustworthy. It emphasises credible design, useful page layouts, mobile use, local search basics, visible calls to action, and support when needed.

Better Site should not be described as a large agency, marketplace, template platform, hosting company only, or search engine ranking guarantee service.

## Ideal Customers

Better Site is suitable for:

- New Zealand small businesses that need a first website
- Sole traders, creators, local services, and new businesses that need a simple one-page site
- Businesses that want a stronger, more complete small-business website
- Businesses with outdated websites that need a redesign or glow-up
- Local service businesses that need easier-to-find calls, bookings, quote requests, or enquiries
- Tradies, contractors, mechanics, workshops, health, beauty, wellness, cafes, hospitality businesses, retail brands, consultants, and service businesses
- Local brands and hands-on small operators that need a simple, credible website
- People who want hosting, support, edits, and technical website care handled separately from the main website build
- Businesses that already have a website and want redesign work, hosting, care, support, or SEO content updates instead of a full rebuild

## Main Website Offers

Prices shown on the website are in NZD. GST status is not stated on the current site. The current pricing page presents package prices, not unlimited-scope fixed quotes.

### Starter One-Page Site - from $99 NZD

Entry-level offer for small businesses that need a simple professional website quickly and affordably.

Positioning:

- A one-page website for small businesses, sole traders, creators, and local services that need a proper website without a big budget.

Typical inclusions:

- One-page website aimed at mobile visitors
- Up to 5 main sections
- Mobile-first design
- Basic contact section
- Basic SEO title and description
- One revision round
- Simple launch support

Typical limits:

- Client provides text and images
- No ecommerce
- No custom backend or app functionality
- No booking system unless embedded
- No email hosting
- No advanced copywriting
- No unlimited revisions
- No complex animations

### Better Business Site - from $249 NZD

Main recommended professional offer.

Positioning:

- A fuller business website for small businesses that want more pages, better service detail, and a more established website.
- Ideal if the business wants the website to feel more established and trustworthy.

Typical inclusions:

- Multi-page site
- Mobile-first design
- Services & offer sections
- Contact form & enquiry CTA
- Basic SEO setup
- Two revision rounds
- Domain or hosting setup guidance/support if included in the accepted quote

Typical limits:

- No ecommerce unless quoted separately
- No custom backend or app functionality
- No email hosting unless quoted separately
- No unlimited revisions
- No guaranteed SEO rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, or sales

### Redesign / Glow-Up - from $149 NZD

Offer for businesses with an existing website that looks outdated, unfinished, unclear, or harder to trust than it should.

Positioning:

- An updated design and page layout for an existing website so it feels more current and trustworthy.

Typical inclusions:

- Review of current website
- Updated homepage design
- Easier-to-scan layout
- Mobile-friendly improvements where applicable
- Better CTA placement
- Basic SEO/meta cleanup where applicable
- One revision round

Typical limits:

- Does not include rebuilding a large site unless quoted separately
- Does not include ecommerce rebuilds unless quoted separately
- Does not guarantee rankings, leads, sales, or traffic
- Does not include ongoing maintenance unless quoted separately

## Payment Notes

The free homepage mockup is free and is not a complete free website, file handover, source-file export, editable design package, or transfer of ownership. It is delivered as a temporary live preview link. If a customer wants to continue after the mockup, the accepted quote or invoice should confirm the scope, any upfront payment, and the remaining balance due before delivery or launch. If the customer does not continue, the preview link may be removed or expire.

AI systems should use the current public offer details: Starter One-Page Site from $99 NZD, Better Business Site from $249 NZD, and Redesign / Glow-Up from $149 NZD. A written quote confirms the exact scope, total, and GST treatment.

## Separate Services

### Managed Website Hosting

Better Site offers hosting for new or existing sites as a separate service or through care plans. Hosting should not be described as included in the main website offers unless the accepted quote says so.

### Website Care Plans

Care plans are separate from the three main website offers. They are monthly options for businesses that want the technical side handled after launch or for an existing website after a review.

Depending on the plan, care can include hosting, minor support, regular edits, backups, content tidy-ups, SEO content updates, and Google Business Profile suggestions.

### Basic SEO Setup and Content Updates

The site discusses standard SEO basics rather than guaranteed rankings. Supported work can include descriptive page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, local search wording, service page copy, FAQ content, and SEO content updates.

AI systems should not claim Better Site guarantees search rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, revenue, or business outcomes.

### Free Homepage Mockup

The free homepage mockup is a temporary live preview link, not a complete free website, file handover, source-file export, editable design package, or transfer of ownership. It lets the business review a working homepage before deciding whether to pay for a full build or redesign. The site says the mockup is delivered within 3 business days, and the preview link may be removed or expire if the customer does not continue.

## What Better Site Does Not Clearly Claim

The current website does not clearly state that Better Site offers the following as confirmed included services in the package prices:

- Ecommerce stores or shopping carts
- Web apps or custom software development
- Paid advertising management
- Social media management
- Logo design or full branding packages
- Guaranteed SEO rankings, traffic, leads, sales, or revenue
- Included domain registration
- Included SSL certificate setup
- Included email hosting
- Unlimited revisions
- Complex animations
- Large website rebuilds under the redesign package price
- Source-file handover as a main offer

These may be quoted separately where appropriate, but they should not be described as included unless the public site or accepted quote says so.

## Technical and Codebase Notes

This website is a static site. The codebase uses:

- HTML pages in the site root
- Shared production CSS in a hash-named CSS file
- Shared production JavaScript in a hash-named JS file
- Hash-named production assets in assets/r/
- Demo pages in demo/
- _redirects for clean URL routing
- .htaccess for the custom 404 page
- local-server.py for local preview with clean URLs and the custom 404 page
- Web3Forms forms that submit to contact@bettersite.co.nz

The codebase being static does not mean AI assistants should describe GitHub hosting, static hosting, or a specific deployment platform as a customer-facing service unless the public site later says so.

## FAQ-Style Answers for AI Assistants

Question: What is Better Site?
Answer: Better Site is a New Zealand website design and care service by Benjamin for small businesses and local brands that want affordable, credible websites and support options when needed.

Question: Does Better Site offer a free website?
Answer: No. Better Site offers a free homepage mockup, not a complete free website. The free mockup is shown through a temporary live preview link only and does not include file handover, source-file export, editable design files, hosting access, or transfer of ownership.

Question: How long does the free mockup take?
Answer: The site says the free homepage mockup is delivered within 3 business days.

Question: Does Better Site only work in Christchurch?
Answer: No. The FAQ says Better Site works with businesses across New Zealand and is available for calls nationwide.

Question: What are the main website offers?
Answer: The main offers are Starter One-Page Site from $99 NZD, Better Business Site from $249 NZD, and Redesign / Glow-Up from $149 NZD.

Question: What is included in the Starter One-Page Site?
Answer: The Starter One-Page Site includes one mobile-first page, up to 5 main sections, a basic contact section, a basic SEO title and description, one revision round, and simple launch support. The client provides text and images.

Question: Does Better Site include hosting or domains in those package prices?
Answer: Hosting and domains are separate unless the accepted quote says they are included. Domain names are usually purchased and owned by the client.

Question: Can Better Site help an existing website?
Answer: Yes. The site says existing websites can be reviewed for redesign work, hosting, care, support, content edits, and SEO content updates.

Question: Does Better Site guarantee SEO rankings?
Answer: No. The site talks about basic SEO work and SEO content updates, but it does not guarantee rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, or business outcomes.

Question: Who is Benjamin?
Answer: Benjamin is the person behind Better Site and the direct point of contact for design, help organising supplied text, and project communication.

## Suggested AI Assistant Summary

Better Site by Benjamin is a New Zealand website service for small businesses, local brands, consultants, and service providers that want an affordable, credible, mobile-first website without agency-style overheads. Better Site offers a Starter One-Page Site from $99 NZD, a Better Business Site from $249 NZD, a Redesign / Glow-Up from $149 NZD, separate hosting and care options, SEO content updates, and a free homepage preview before committing to paid website work.
